d:
Set against the chaotic charm of UP and NCR (Delhi-Gurgaon), the film blends humour, romance, and nostalgia. The narrative is elevated by a vibrant soundtrack that perfectly complements every mood, from college madness and first love to heartbreak and the bittersweet journey of figuring life out.

This rom-com is a relatable, entertaining ride about finding love, finding yourself, and laughing through the messiness of growing up.
